comments.text:
I swap footwear throughout my day.  I roll the socks and legs together.  The sock goes over my calf, then roll the sock down to preferred height or tension (autistic here) tucking the legging of my pants into the sock. It gives it a jogger taper look on chinos.  None the less, it’s great no matter what boot i put on I can slip footwear on off be ready to dive into heaven knows what. 

Just super nice knowing my leggings are not getting splatted with the places I go 
Forest, farms, door dashing, auto detailing,  mom’s mud yard renovation project lol.   😂 just never know. Hahaha 😮. Utilitarian
